question: Must this PR provide fresh real-behavior proof for head a17909af before merge, or will maintainers explicitly accept the earlier-head Testbox evidence for the final migration and durability additions?
rationale: The code and hosted checks are clean, but repository policy treats after-fix real setup evidence as a merge gate for an external PR, and the cited Testbox run predates material persisted-state changes.

options.title: Require exact-head proof
options.body: Obtain redacted Testbox or emulator evidence covering the final dropped-ACK, restart, Retry, and v2→v3 upgrade paths before merge.

options.title: Accept earlier-head proof
options.body: Explicitly waive source drift and merge based on deterministic tests and hosted CI without real setup proof for the final additions.
